lines.text: In the twentieth year, Nehemiah is in the citadel of Susa when his brother Hanani arrives with men from Judah.
The men report that Jerusalem's wall is broken down and its gates have been burned with fire.
Nehemiah sits down and weeps, then mourns for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
Nehemiah confesses that Israel has sinned and asks God to remember His word to Abraham about scattering the unfaithful.
Nehemiah asks God to grant him mercy in the sight of the man, and he is chief baker to the king.
